purpose: The changelog in plain language: what changed per version for the child and the parent, newest first (0.28.0 down to 0.11).
details: Each version has a heading 'x.y.z — title' and bullets; the father's release procedure copies the text into the GitHub release. Versions 0.27.0 and 0.28.0 say 'you see nothing different' (groundwork for the new screens). Older entries (0.12 and below) are one-liners. The current version number is VERSIE in leeravontuur/__init__.py and must match the top heading.
summary: Changelog from 0.28.0 (building blocks for the new screens, invisible to the child) back to 0.11, covering: 0.27 cleanup, 0.26 verb spelling (weak/strong verbs, participle, put in the past), 0.25 sentence parsing, 0.24 mixed practice, 0.23 stop lock and new main menu, 0.22 parent answer log, 0.21 digital clock/klad kept/stop confirmations/cheat sheet after tips/place values, 0.20 new menus and start files, 0.19 the fixed work method, 0.18 clock, 0.17-0.16 word problems, 0.15 geometry, 0.14 more units, 0.13 first beta, and earlier topic releases.
